remarks:
Custom craftsmanship, refinished kitchen & bathrooms and an inviting open-concept layout make this extensively remodeled Lancaster home stand out! Completely remodeled over the past seven years, this four-bedroom home combines distinctive finishes with substantial updates for comfortable, move-in-ready living.

At the heart of the home, the kitchen showcases custom hickory cabinetry with rich natural tones and striking wood grain, complemented by quartz countertops. The open connection between the kitchen, dining and living areas creates a welcoming setting for everything from everyday meals to holiday gatherings, with an easy flow that keeps everyone connected. Sliding glass doors bring in natural light and lead to the large backyard, offering plenty of space for outdoor entertaining, gardening, recreation or simply relaxing in the fresh air.

Four bedrooms provide plenty of room to spread out, with flexibility for guests, a home office or hobbies. The primary bedroom features two large closets for generous wardrobe storage. Beautifully refinished bathrooms continue the home’s updated appeal. The main bath offers a large vanity with quartz countertops, tile flooring and a classic subway tile tub surround. The stylish half bath features a rectangular vessel sink, sleek contemporary faucet and a striking mosaic tile backsplash in shades of white, gray and deep blue, with a round mirror completing the polished look.

A partially finished basement adds versatile space for recreation or hobbies, along with room for storage. The attached two-car garage provides sheltered parking and everyday convenience, while a new front door creates a welcoming entrance.

The improvements extend well beyond the finishes. Windows were replaced, electrical panel was updated, and a high-efficiency boiler was installed in 2022. A new sump pump with battery backup adds another valuable improvement.

With its standout custom kitchen, spacious bedrooms, beautifully updated bathrooms, flexible basement space and large backyard, 52 Harvey Drive offers an appealing blend of indoor comfort and outdoor enjoyment!

Offers will be reviewed beginning Wednesday (10/21) at 12:00pm.
